A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Which countries can I enquire about?+

Our existing coverage information lists 100+ countries and highlights the USA, Canada, UK, Germany, UAE and Australia. Contact the team for an exact destination and postcode check.

Can I send food, medicines or cosmetics abroad?+

These categories appear in our existing shipment list, but acceptance is not universal. Share the item details and destination so the team can check the requirements before you prepare or book a shipment.

How long will international delivery take?+

The estimate depends on the origin, destination, chosen service and shipment requirements. Ask for a shipment-specific transit estimate with your quotation.
